hypothesis: Supervised projected-history to projected-query alignment can extract some true factual action-consequence associations from the exact frozen original four-block hybrid pre-TTT representations on unfamiliar worlds; compare against raw-action memory under identical episode observations, and preserve failure if not.

source.fit_val: 16D random per-world orthogonal 8 target action keys repeated twice, 8 singleton normalized random distractor keys; independent target and distractor tanh effect vectors 16D; randomly interleaved 24 executed factual (action, observed effect) events; one final target-action query, withheld consequence label.
source.ood: Fresh independently generated per-world causal mapping and action basis with 8 targets repeated twice plus 32 singleton distractor events, randomly interleaved 48 facts; new source seed, longer interference, unchanged generated effect distribution.
source.future_label: Historical input=32D concatenated observed action and effect only; final query=16D executed action key concatenated with 16 zeros; never provide future effect to model or future query during factual ingestion.
source.exclusions: P65-P75 previously consumed sources are forbidden; this is a different RNG cohort in same author-designed synthetic task family, NOT independently authenticated source or truly novel external environment.
source.source_audit: FIT/VAL before training: four quartiles target-position deviation<=0.05, heldout index-only balanced accuracy<=0.55. OOD cohort generated/scored once only after VAL eligibility. Ensure no role or ground-truth future labels passed to learner.

mechanisms.native: Frozen original model.HybridPilot(32,16,Config(width=16,heads=2,ssm=true,attention=true,ttt=true,depth=true)); exactly original stem->SSM->causal attention->TTT LayerNorm; historical TTT key projections and final TTT query projection, no source or weight changes. Three distinct frozen model seeds.
mechanisms.learned_native: Two independently initialized trainable 16x16 linear transforms (512 trainable scalars total) mapping native historical key vectors and native final query vector into common normalized cosine addressing space; no bias; supervised contrastive objective logsumexp(all facts) minus logsumexp(positive matches), where positives derive only from repeated executed action identity equal to final query action; no target effect labels or role labels passed to address map. Predict effect by selecting actually observed historical consequence at highest projected cosine.
mechanisms.learned_raw_control: Same exact 512-parameter trainable matching architecture trained identically on raw 16D historical actions and final raw 16D action, using same positive matching objective; isolate original frozen projected representation information loss.
mechanisms.frozen_native: Original random pre-TTT projected key/query cosine nearest historical observed consequence (no training) baseline.
mechanisms.raw_exact: Raw factual action-key cosine nearest observed consequence (nonprivileged but retains full 24/48-fact history and extra state), strong control.
mechanisms.credit_negative: Shuffle only actually observed historical effects across distinct events within each world, keeping query and future true effect unchanged; compare trained native OOD MSE; action-credit must matter.
mechanisms.untrained_model: Original HybridPilot parameters stay byte-identical to initial state; original native integrated output quality is NOT measured by this experiment.

training.initial: N(0,0.1) added to identity per 16x16 projection, separate RNG per model seed
training.selection: lowest held-out VAL contrastive loss; report VAL address hit@1 and consequence MSE for chosen checkpoint

gates.pre_ood: FIT/VAL source audits pass, raw fixed VAL exact-address hit@1>=0.99 and MSE<=1e-5, three independent original seeds + independent aligner seeds and original byte preservation, finite gradients and loss, model VAL top1>=0.35 and VAL MSE<=0.85*zero for EACH native alignment seed, cold restoration bitwise exact on a fixed VAL batch. Otherwise STOP before OOD creation/scoring.
gates.primary: On one held-out OOD dev cohort, each native aligner top1 correct-action retrieval>=0.50 and MSE<=0.70*zero-state OOD MSE, and each improves on its own untrained frozen-native address MSE by >=20% (not required to beat raw strong control). 2000 paired bootstrap world resamples seed 760401 95% lower relative improvement bound over frozen-native >0.
gates.negatives: For each model seed incorrect-credit OOD consequence error>=2x trained native correct-credit OOD MSE; raw retrieval remains near exact; cold checkpoint restore bitwise equal; no final effect leaked into address features.
gates.stronger_control: Report trained raw counterpart on same data and train updates; do NOT describe a native win over conventional raw retrieval unless measured native MSE is lower. Raw conventional full-history state and model CPU time/FLOPs not capacity matched.
gates.strict: DEV_PASS_NATIVE_ALIGNER_TRANSFER only if all pre-OOD/primary/negative controls pass for all three seeds. SCIENTIFIC_PASS is always false; native key/query alignment isolated head is not a trained original four-block hybrid.
gates.exit: Stop on failures without OOD evaluation where preregistered; do not posthoc tune gate/thresholds based on consumed OOD. Record negative and full cost/custody.
